Ingestion from services → redaction of PCI fields → envelope encryption with KMS → per-tenant topics → immutable storage (S3/Object Lock) → SIEM ingestion for detection and alerting → dashboards and audits.

## Why This Is Asked

- **Service Identity**: SPIRE provides X.509 SVIDs for mutual TLS

```javascript
  permissions: ['read'],
  ttl: 3600 // 1 hour
}, { spiIdentity: clientSPIFFE });
```
